description: This source file defines a custom exception class TransferNotSupportedException that extends AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException, indicating a not supported transfer action within the system. It also contains an enum TransferNotSupportedReason which categorizes various reasons why a transfer might be unsupported, each providing specific error messages and codes.
